name: Certified Developer in AI

fee.note: Red Hat prices the exam by country in its training store; no US price could be read for this listing.

exam.format: Performance-based exam: hands-on tasks on Red Hat OpenShift AI 3.3 and OpenShift Container Platform 4.20, taken remotely or at a Red Hat or partner testing station. Product documentation is provided, but tasks must be done without assistance.

discounts.text: The AI267LS Red Hat Learning Subscription Course (the AI267 course plus one EX267 attempt) is 50% off local MSRP.

access.retake: One free retake after an unsuccessful first attempt (a no-show counts), to be scheduled and taken within one year of the original purchase; further attempts are paid, and the same exam cannot be taken twice in one day.
access.accommodations: Special accommodation requests (for a disability, or a head covering worn for religious or medical reasons) must be made at least two weeks before the exam.

scope: Workbenches, connections, model serving/registry, monitoring, pipelines, evaluation, RAG and agents.
ai_policy: Issuer says tasks should be performed without assistance; check the current exam resource rules.
caveats: The 50% AI267LS offer applies to the course subscription, which includes one exam attempt, not to a standalone exam purchase; regional checkout and final price were not tested.
The EX267 page does not state the exam length, a passing score or the exam languages, and the regional price list did not load for this check.
Parts of the exam page still use the former name, Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift AI.

timeline.text: Last day of the 50%-off AI267LS course offer, which includes one EX267 attempt.
